subject: Initial BenefitFlow remote project baseline published
body: BenefitFlow beta v0.3.0 project core was published to boberino93-bit/benefitflow main at baseline commit 3aeb7b8cd955e7435039e8d3e2ea04f66d68bd64. This baseline contains the isolated BenefitFlow AgentBus/forum, recursive backup and successor-revalidation contracts, beta application code, tests, and recovery utilities. Duo Open remains foreign and denied. The BenefitFlow R&D round remains blocked pending explicit user start.
